dependency_findings.models: FNO1D, FNO2D, physical-frequency FNO2D and Track A use repository implementations built on torch and the standard library.
dependency_findings.neuraloperator_required: No imports or environment entries found in the inspected sources
dependency_findings.legacy_requirements_problem: Many entries point to obsolete file:///home/... and file:///croot/... build paths; do not install this requirements file directly.
dependency_findings.cuda_version_warning: The old cuda-version=12.9 meta-package is not evidence that torch used CUDA 12.9. Runtime records and pytorch-cuda establish 12.1.
dependency_findings.official_wheel_difference: torch 2.5.1+cu121 for CPython 3.10 requires sympy==1.13.1, while the old Conda environment contains sympy 1.14.0. The old Conda torch dependency on sympy is unpinned.
dependency_findings.numeric_backend_difference: Official pip NumPy/SciPy wheels may use a different BLAS backend from the old MKL Conda environment; a wheel deployment is not a bitwise-identical reconstruction.

recommended_plan.isolation: Create only the approved fno_kerr Conda prefix. Leave base and underwater unchanged.
recommended_plan.exact_conda_recovery_alternative: Resolve the original pytorch Conda build and MKL-backed NumPy/SciPy if closer historical binary parity is required; do not mix the old SymPy pin blindly into the wheel route.
recommended_plan.estimate_note: Planning estimates, not measured FNO installation values. The original 194 Conda metadata records total 3274578787 compressed bytes, excluding pip-only packages. Official torch wheel alone is 780429430 bytes.
recommended_plan.cache_reuse: Most underwater CUDA 12.6 and CPython 3.11 artifacts cannot satisfy CUDA 12.1 and CPython 3.10 pins. Reuse only exact matching versions, tags and hashes.
